fullContent:
Pippalyadi Thailam (Oil) 
 Reference: Bheshaj Ratnavali Arshorogadhikara 115-118. 
 Introduction 
 Pippalyadi Thailam (Oil) is an herbal and Ayurvedic oil, used to treat piles with its external application. It is also has Ayurvedic Panchakarma treatment called as Anuvasana Basti. 
 Ingredients 
 8.7 grams of each of:- 
 
 Pippali (Long pepper) (Piper longum) 
 Madhuka (Licorice) (Glycyrrhiza glabra) 
 Bilva (Aegle marmelos) 
 Shatahva (Anethum sowa) 
 Madana (Randia spinosa) 
 Vacha (Acorus calamus) 
 Kushta (Saussurea lappa) 
 Shati (Hedychium spicatum) 
 Pushkarahva (Inula racemosa) 
 Chitraka (Plumbago zeylanica) 
 Devadaru (Cedrus deodara) 
 Taila (Sesamum indicum) Oil – 768 ml 
 Ksheera (Cow milk) – 1.536 literrs 
 
 How to Use? 
 This oil is for external application. It is also useful for Anuvasana Basti, a Panchakarma treatmet where oil is used as enema. 
 Use it under strict doctors prescribed time. 
 Therapeutic Uses 
 
 This oil is ver useful in treating piles. 
 Also good in gout, weakness in lower back and lower limbs, lumbar and cervical spondylosis. 
 It can even treat constipation 
 
 Contraindications/Side Effects 
 It might leads to little burning sensation in people having Pitta body type 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
